tool_input.description: Format the file and build the engine

result:
I implemented `RegExp.escape` and its `EncodeForRegExpEscape` helper in `crates/kahvi-builtins/src/reg_exp/escape.rs`, the only file I changed. The build and clippy are clean, and `./t262 built-ins/RegExp/escape/` passes 38 of 40 runs. The 2 failures are in `escaped-otherpunctuators.js` and throw "not implemented: String.prototype.codePointAt", which the test calls and which the engine doesn't have yet.

The file has private helpers for `EncodeForRegExpEscape`, `UnicodeEscape`, `WhiteSpace`, `LineTerminator`, `StringToCodePoints` and `UTF16EncodeCodePoint`. I wrote them locally because nothing in `kahvi_core::ops` provides them and no other built-in shares them yet. The rest of the spec steps are commented above their code.

BLOCKED: String.prototype.codePointAt is not implemented, and escaped-otherpunctuators.js needs it
